title: Add a new auto-joining proof suite with one green proof
prompt: Create a new proof suite scripts/benchcanary/ following this repo's suite convention exactly: (1) scripts/benchcanary/run-all.sh — copy the glob template used by scripts/party/run-all.sh (shopt nullglob loop over prove-*.ts via ~/.bun/bin/bun, non-zero exit on failure), executable; (2) scripts/benchcanary/prove-canary.ts — a bun proof asserting that src/utils/model/seatSlots.ts exports PARTY_SEAT_DEFAULTS with tank model 'claude-opus-4-8[1m]' (import the module and check, using the check/section helper style of the sibling proofs). The suite must exit 0.
